source_clause: LS2.) When the (-, +) seat control buttons are pressed, it will trigger the popup or tab change within climate, and only on the second press will be reflected.
reasoning: 驗證目標：13.3（LS2.）第一次按壓只觸發 popup 或 tab 切換，調整要到第二次按壓才 reflected。關鍵情境條件：按壓序數為唯一變數，其餘條件兩條 TC 相同。為什麼這樣切：兩個 037 leaf 對應兩個階段，以按壓序數為 distinguishing axis 分兩條（§4.6）。刻意略過：popup 與 tab 切換何者發生由 13.2 之分支決定，本節不重複驗證該分支（§8.2.1 不擴張至 sibling）。ER 錨定條文自身之 reflected，不引入 13.6 才使用之 level（20 §4）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: lower screen Seats tab 與座椅控制

tcs.tc_title: First press triggers the popup or tab change only
tcs.test_item: When the (-, +) seat control buttons are pressed, the system shall trigger the popup or tab change within climate, and only on the second press will the adjustment be reflected
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls (13.2)
2. [spec-derived] The door control carries the seat control (-, +) buttons for lumbar and bolster (13.2)
3. [test-setup] The Seats tab is not currently shown, and the lumbar/bolster level is away from both its minimum and its maximum
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Record the lumbar/bolster state shown before the adjustment
2. Press "+" once on the door seat control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The lumbar/bolster state before the adjustment is shown
2. The popup or the tab change is shown, and the adjustment is not reflected

tcs.tc_title: Second press applies the lumbar adjustment
tcs.test_item: When the (-, +) seat control buttons are pressed, only on the second press will the adjustment be reflected
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls (13.2)
2. [spec-derived] The door control carries the seat control (-, +) buttons for lumbar and bolster (13.2)
3. [spec-derived] The first press has already triggered the popup or the tab change (13.3)
4. [test-setup] The lumbar/bolster level is away from both its minimum and its maximum
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Record the lumbar/bolster state shown before the adjustment
2. Press "+" a second time on the door seat control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The lumbar/bolster state before the adjustment is shown
2. The adjustment is reflected
